result.brief: 以世界建模为统一视角综述视频基础模型，围绕读、写、共享、交互四种操作组织表征、模型、数据与评测，并指出从感知保真转向持久状态与可控演化的趋势。
result.reason: Survey unifies video understanding and generation via world modeling, covering representations, unified models, and action-conditioned state prediction—directly aligned with world model and unified understanding/generation interests.
